input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding Sparkling, so the preferred position (no restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build) is met. Section 3 ("Restrictions on Use", p0031–p0039) is limited to the scope of the licence in the Work itself — no copying, no reverse engineering, no sublicensing/transfer, no use as a service bureau — and does not restrain us from acquiring, developing or licensing competing routing systems. Section 19 (p0133) is a mutual employee non-solicitation, not a non-compete, and is addressed under the non-solicitation rule rather than here. The general matters clauses (p0135–p0149) contain no exclusivity, territory or competing-products restriction, and the confidentiality provisions expressly carve out independently developed information (p0098). No redline required.
